Just a quick Solovair - Blundstones comparison. I know they're a different style, but I religiously wore my Solovair 8 eyes in the UK, the toe box shredded the tops of my toes breaking them in. They aren't waterproof, even with dubbin, and they cut up laces as you described. Moved out to Vietnam, and needed a boot that I can slip on and off easily so bought a pair of Blundstones. And what a difference they are in terms of comfort and weather performance. I ride motorbikes daily, live in an area with a crazy rainy season, and walk in both high heat jungle, and temperate mountains. The Blundstones took no breaking in, are seemingly waterproof (which is weird seeing as they have the gusset and a soft leather), and have totally converted me into seeing them as an every day choice. The most practical thing I've ever put my foot in, and look so good with some light wash jeans and a shirt. Thanks Aussies.
